correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the four-letter substitution, parity rule and many-to-one binary coding. Independent recomputation found identical length-67 factor languages in substitution stages 11 and 12, each with 528 factors, and 80 length-11 factors. The exact sigma(F_L) closure lemma turns these stable finite factors into the complete infinite-word language. Recomputed all 1024 delay subsets at horizon 10 (32 qualify, minimum cardinality five) and all C(33,4)=40920 even four-subsets through delay 66; exactly {2,14,64,66} and {2,52,64,66} cover. The no-three-shift global lower bound correctly uses published binary Rudin-Shapiro Theorem 28; it is not inferred from finite enumeration. Every quantifier over the one-sided fixed point and distinct literal symbols is respected.
